verdict.rationale: Runpod is GPU and compute infrastructure, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is outside its product role. The evidence only shows Runpod publishing its own MCP servers for other agents to connect to, which is the server role and does not make this client-side story applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
